name: Screen-Space Fluid Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Van der Laan et al. pipeline
definition: A screen-space rendering pipeline for real-time visualization of particle-based fluid simulations (e.g., SPH) that converts discrete particle data into a continuous fluid volume appearance using depth and thickness buffers, avoiding expensive ray tracing.
summary: Screen-Space Fluid Rendering Pipeline converts particle data into continuous fluid volumes by accumulating sphere thickness in screen-space buffers to derive normals and opacity, enabling interactive rendering of millions of particles.
